description: Declarative Meshy image-generation pipeline expansion with deterministic ImageMagick post-processing.
rules: Use --dry-run for credential-free, network-free plan validation.
This package owns pipeline expansion and deterministic local post-processing; vendor-fabric owns Meshy authentication, HTTP, retries, polling, downloads, and vendor error translation.
Use --fixture-image to exercise local post-processing without a paid generation request.
